title: CampaignPulse AI — Adobe Campaign Edition
creator: Sangram Ghatge
summary: Turns aggregate email campaign metrics into deterministic KPIs, evidence-backed campaign health findings and prioritized Adobe Campaign operational checks.
human_outcome: A practitioner can understand what happened, see what needs investigation and decide what to check next.
agent_outcome: An AI agent can follow the documented input contract, validation sequence, metric definitions, evidence rules and output format.
execution: Standalone; aggregate and synthetic data only; no Adobe Campaign API or credentials
safety: Human verifies findings and approves actions
